technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with short-term bullish technicals (supertrend, hull, psar) offset by overbought conditions, medium-term resistance (price below 50/200 MAs), and lack of triggered strategies; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: VMC shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 50 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market fear (44 VIX-equivalent) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but stale trades (301+ days old) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (459.2), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising USD pressures Materials multinationals, FOMC event in 1 day adds binary risk, and earnings in 50 days creates additional uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technicals (supertrend, hull, psar bullish) with price near support (170.33) and CMF/force index crossovers suggest immediate momentum, while VIX fear presents contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators, price trapped below 50/200 MAs, zero fundamental/smart money support, FOMC event in 1 day, earnings in 50 days, and macro crisis (VIX 459.2, flat yield curve, rising USD) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 1 day and earnings in 50 days create binary risk; VIX at crisis levels (459.2) and flat yield curve signal recession; price trapped below 50/200 MAs indicates medium-term weakness.
